# Azure Resource Manager keyvault client library for Java

Azure Resource Manager keyvault client library for Java

For documentation on how to use this package, please see [Azure Management Libraries for Java](https://aka.ms/azsdk/java/mgmt).

## Getting started

### Prerequisites

- [Java Development Kit (JDK)][jdk] with version 8 or above
- [Azure Subscription][azure_subscription]

### Adding the package to your product

[//]: # ({x-version-update-start;com.azure.resourcemanager:azure-resourcemanager-keyvault;current})
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.azure.resourcemanager</groupId>
    <artifactId>azure-resourcemanager-keyvault</artifactId>
    <version>2.56.0</version>
</dependency>
```
[//]: # ({x-version-update-end})

### Include the recommended packages

Azure Management Libraries require a `TokenCredential` implementation for authentication and an `HttpClient` implementation for HTTP client.

[Azure Identity][azure_identity] package and [Azure Core Netty HTTP][azure_core_http_netty] package provide the default implementation.

### Authentication

Microsoft Entra ID token authentication relies on the [credential class][azure_identity_credentials] from [Azure Identity][azure_identity] package.

Azure subscription ID can be configured via `AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID` environment variable.
Azure tenant ID can be configured via `AZURE_TENANT_ID` environment variable.

Assuming the use of the `DefaultAzureCredential` credential class, the client can be authenticated using the following code:

```java readme-sample-authenticate
AzureProfile profile = new AzureProfile(AzureCloud.AZURE_PUBLIC_CLOUD);
TokenCredential credential = new DefaultAzureCredentialBuilder()
    .authorityHost(profile.getEnvironment().getActiveDirectoryEndpoint())
    .build();
KeyVaultManager manager = KeyVaultManager
    .authenticate(credential, profile);
```

The sample code assumes global Azure. Please change `AzureEnvironment.AZURE` variable if otherwise.

See [Authentication][authenticate] for more options.

proposals.subtype: Access policy inherits its parent's tenant as a UUID
proposals.explanation: The access-policy constructor sets the inner tenantId to UUID.fromString(parent.tenantId()).
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete parent-bound facade constructor initializes model state from its parent, beyond an empty constructor. Unknown kind and missing regeneration history qualify ownership; absence of Generated alone is insufficient.

proposals.subtype: String facade for UUID tenant and application properties
proposals.explanation: tenantId/applicationId return null or the inner value's string representation; forTenantId/forApplicationId parse strings with UUID.fromString before updating the inner model.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade getters/setters explicitly change the property representation in both directions. This is not a custom wire serializer or evidence of token authentication.

proposals.subtype: Directory principal objects projected to policy object IDs
proposals.explanation: The ActiveDirectoryUser, ActiveDirectoryGroup and ServicePrincipal overloads take each supplied object's id and set the policy inner objectId.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level overloads adapt typed directory-resource inputs into a policy model value. No directory lookup, identity resolution or SDK auth-policy behavior is inferred.

proposals.subtype: Named principal overloads retain separate facade state
proposals.explanation: forUser(String) stores userPrincipalName and forServicePrincipal(String) stores servicePrincipalName in separate facade fields exposed by package-private getters rather than immediately setting inner objectId.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The supplied overloads implement an alternate input/staging path beyond plain generated model setters. The missing parent consumer prevents claiming any subsequent name resolution.

proposals.subtype: Initialized deduplicated key-permission additions
proposals.explanation: Varargs/list allowKeyPermissions overloads initialize nested Permissions and keys when absent, then append each supplied permission only if not already present.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete policy facade helpers implement initialization and membership-aware mutation beyond generated list setters. Existing duplicates are not globally removed.

proposals.subtype: Initialized deduplicated secret-permission additions
proposals.explanation: Varargs/list allowSecretPermissions overloads initialize nested Permissions and secrets when absent, then append only supplied values not already contained.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete facade helpers add membership-aware permission mutation over inner models, not credential or signing policy. Generation history is unavailable.

proposals.subtype: Initialized deduplicated certificate-permission additions
proposals.explanation: Varargs/list allowCertificatePermissions initialize nested Permissions and certificates if needed and append each value only when absent from the certificate list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level list recipes implement initialization and membership tests rather than a raw property setter. Unknown provenance is qualified.

proposals.subtype: Initialized deduplicated storage-permission additions
proposals.explanation: Varargs/list allowStoragePermissions initialize nested Permissions and storage if needed, then append only values not already in that list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade methods provide membership-aware collection construction above inner models. They do not prove global set normalization or generated baseline behavior.

proposals.subtype: Grant all values known to each permission enum
proposals.explanation: The four allow-all helpers iterate the corresponding permission type's values() and call its named allow helper for each value.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit higher-level enumeration recipes compose the supplied permission builders. They enumerate SDK-known values, not necessarily every permission a service could ever support.

proposals.subtype: Certificate-permission removal list/varargs adapters
proposals.explanation: Certificate disallow overloads initialize certificate permissions and removeAll the supplied list, or Arrays.asList of the supplied varargs.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade bodies implement removal and input-shape adaptation above nested model lists rather than generated assignment. No service persistence is inferred.

proposals.subtype: Key removals call the secret initializer
proposals.explanation: Both key disallow overloads call initializeSecretPermissions, then removeAll from permissions().keys(); the varargs overload uses Arrays.asList.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level mutation/overload bodies are supplied. The initializer/target mismatch is preserved exactly, not silently corrected into key initialization or claimed null-safe.

proposals.subtype: Secret-permission removal list/varargs adapters
proposals.explanation: Secret disallow overloads initialize secret permissions then removeAll the supplied list or Arrays.asList of varargs from secrets.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete facade methods adapt inputs and mutate the nested list rather than simply expose a model property. No broader transaction or service guarantee is established.

proposals.subtype: Storage-permission removal list/varargs adapters
proposals.explanation: Storage disallow overloads initialize storage permissions then removeAll the supplied list or Arrays.asList of varargs from storage.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete policy facade mutation/overload adapters are supplied above generated-style model setters. Ownership history is absent.

proposals.subtype: Initialize and clear key, secret or storage permissions
proposals.explanation: The key, secret and storage disallow-all helpers initialize their respective nested list and clear that list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete facade methods combine missing-state initialization and destructive list mutation, beyond raw property exports. They are distinct from the captured certificate mismatch.

proposals.subtype: Certificate-named clear initializes certificates but clears secrets
proposals.explanation: disallowCertificateAllPermissions invokes initializeCertificatePermissions, then calls permissions().secrets().clear() and returns this.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The complete facade body contains an explicit initialization/mutation recipe. Its actual target is reported without assuming the method name describes its effect or proving a runtime defect.

proposals.subtype: Attach forwards the policy to its parent facade
proposals.explanation: attach invokes parent().withAccessPolicy(this) before returning the parent.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The body performs an actual child-to-parent integration call, not merely an empty attach or parent getter. The parent implementation and subsequent service update are uncaptured.

proposals.subtype: Nested deleted-vault details exposed on the public facade
proposals.explanation: location, deletionDate, scheduledPurgeDate and tags read their values from innerModel().properties() while presenting top-level facade getters.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The supplied higher-level wrapper explicitly flattens nested model properties into its public shape. It provides no null guard or copy policy, and generation ownership remains uncertain.

proposals.subtype: Key state reset and identifier-bound cryptography client construction
proposals.explanation: init clears createKeyRequest and replaces update options; when innerModel is nonnull it reuses those properties and, if requested, builds CryptographyAsyncClient from the inner key ID, stored pipeline and fixed V7_2 service version.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade state/client composition is supplied above external clients. Only captured call sites establish initialization timing; constructors and getInnerAsync do not call init in their supplied bodies.

proposals.subtype: Cached JSON Web Key or a named key fetch
proposals.explanation: getJsonWebKeyAsync returns Mono.just of cached jsonWebKey when present; otherwise it calls getInnerAsync, whose named getKey mapping updates the cached key and returns properties, then maps to the cache. A synchronous partner blocks.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade state-dependent retrieval and cache population are visible. This is not the catalog's LRU/time-expiring response cache and does not prove metadata installation or cryptography initialization.

proposals.subtype: Stored key name and version-property pages mapped to key facades
proposals.explanation: listVersionsAsync supplies this.name() to listPropertiesOfKeyVersions and maps pages with wrapModel, which constructs KeyImpl from each KeyProperties plus stored pipeline/client; listVersions creates a PagedIterable.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level list and model-wrapper bodies bind the resource and project page items. No custom next-link behavior or initialized cryptography client is inferred.

proposals.subtype: Backup helper uses the facade's stored key name
proposals.explanation: backupAsync forwards this.name() to the supplied key client's backupKey; backup blocks on that helper.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete higher-level methods remove the repeated key-name argument above a client operation. They do not implement backup cryptography, encoding or streaming themselves.

proposals.subtype: Encryption result narrowed to ciphertext bytes
proposals.explanation: encryptAsync delegates algorithm/content to CryptographyAsyncClient.encrypt and maps EncryptResult::getCipherText; encrypt blocks on it.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit facade overload/result adaptation is supplied above the cryptography client. This is not a new encryption algorithm, envelope-encryption implementation or claim about the delegate's execution location.

proposals.subtype: Decryption result narrowed to plaintext bytes
proposals.explanation: decryptAsync delegates algorithm/content and maps DecryptResult::getPlainText; decrypt blocks on that helper.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level cryptography result shaping is visible. The underlying algorithm, network/local behavior and client initialization guarantees are not established.

proposals.subtype: Digest-signing result narrowed to signature bytes
proposals.explanation: signAsync forwards the supplied algorithm/digest to the cryptography client and maps SignResult::getSignature; sign blocks.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade methods adapt the delegated operation's result. They do not hash the input, implement signing primitives or sign SDK HTTP requests.

proposals.subtype: Verification result narrowed to validity with a primitive sync adapter
proposals.explanation: verifyAsync maps the cryptography client's VerifyResult::isValid; verify blocks and passes that value through ResourceManagerUtils.toPrimitiveBoolean.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level result and synchronous type adaptation are supplied. The unread boolean helper's null policy and the delegate's verification algorithm are not inferred.

proposals.subtype: Key-wrap result narrowed to encrypted-key bytes
proposals.explanation: wrapKeyAsync delegates algorithm/key and maps WrapResult::getEncryptedKey; wrapKey blocks on it.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade operation/result adapters are supplied above the cryptography client. No local key-wrapping scheme or SDK authentication signing is implemented by these bodies.

proposals.subtype: Key-unwrap result narrowed to key bytes
proposals.explanation: unwrapKeyAsync delegates algorithm/key and maps UnwrapResult::getKey; unwrapKey blocks.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The higher-level facade explicitly narrows the delegated result. It does not expose evidence of a custom unwrap algorithm or guarantee that all constructor paths initialize the client.

proposals.subtype: Key type selects creation options and operation, with import fallback
proposals.explanation: withKeyTypeToCreate builds EC/RSA options with hardware protection selected by the HSM key-type constant, otherwise generic options; createResourceAsync dispatches by option subtype or imports when no create request, then adopts returned properties/key, calls init(true) and returns this.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade option construction and operation-selection bodies implement a higher-level lifecycle over external key clients. This is not the delegate's key-generation algorithm or a reproduced generator baseline.

proposals.subtype: Optional create/import and staged-update reactive composition
proposals.explanation: updateResourceAsync retains update options, conditionally composes createResourceAsync with a callback copying enabled/expiry/not-before/tags/operations into refreshed state, and chains updateKeyProperties with returned properties/key adoption, init(false) and this as result.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full facade method implements multi-stage local-state/reactive composition above client operations. It does not prove merged values are the eventual wire arguments, transactional ordering or failure recovery.

proposals.subtype: Tags and selected attributes routed by create/import/update state
proposals.explanation: withTags and withAttributes choose create options, import options or update properties based on id-null create mode and available requests; attributes copies only enabled, expiresOn, notBefore and tags.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade methods route caller settings into separate operation-specific request state. They do not guarantee initialized update state or that a create-mode call with neither request changes anything.

proposals.subtype: Import request creation and HSM flag use explicit state guards
proposals.explanation: withLocalKeyToImport creates ImportKeyOptions only when importKeyRequest is null and otherwise logs/throws IllegalStateException; withHsm updates that request's hardware flag only when nonnull and otherwise logs/throws.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual facade request/staging guards and error paths are supplied. The literal conditions are reported without inferring an unseen import lifecycle or that init clears importKeyRequest.

proposals.subtype: List/varargs key-operation options routed by mode
proposals.explanation: withKeyOperations converts a list to an array for createKeyRequest in create mode or retains the list reference in update state otherwise; the varargs overload delegates using Arrays.asList.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete facade overloads adapt container shape and operation state above client options. They do not defensively copy the update list or guard a missing create request.

proposals.subtype: RSA size and EC curve setters only apply to matching options
proposals.explanation: withKeySize sets a size only when createKeyRequest is CreateRsaKeyOptions; withKeyCurveName sets a curve only for CreateEcKeyOptions. Both return this when the type condition is not met.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual facade methods apply caller input to subtype-specific request options. Their nonmatching path is reported as shown, not replaced with validation or claimed to configure every key type.

proposals.subtype: URL path tokens become key name/version lookup arguments
proposals.explanation: getByIdAsync parses name/version from URL.getPath().split("/") positions2/3 with null fallbacks for short paths and delegates to getByNameAndVersionAsync; parser MalformedURLException becomes IllegalStateException with a fixed message, and getById blocks.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete higher-level ID-to-operation adapters and parser error paths are supplied. They do not bind the operation client to the input URL's host or validate every ID component.

proposals.subtype: Optional version chooses a key lookup overload and facade result
proposals.explanation: getByNameAndVersionAsync requires nonnull name, calls getKey(name) when version is null or getKey(name,version) otherwise, and maps through wrapModel; named lookup and synchronous partners expose the facade, with null-aware KeyVaultKey wrapping.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual facade lookup/result adapters select operation shape and construct KeyImpl above the external key client. Constructors do not establish fully initialized cryptography state.

proposals.subtype: Key property pages become resource facades
proposals.explanation: listAsync maps listPropertiesOfKeys pages through wrapModel using PagedConverter.mapPage; wrapModel returns null for null properties or constructs KeyImpl with its name/properties and stored pipeline/client. list creates a PagedIterable.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete higher-level page-item adaptation is supplied above external client results. PagedConverter internals and continuation algorithms are absent.

proposals.subtype: Restored key result converted to the management-layer key facade
proposals.explanation: restoreAsync forwards backup bytes to restoreKeyBackup and maps the returned key through wrapModel; restore blocks on it.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual higher-level restore/result adaptation is visible. These bodies do not themselves implement backup decryption or guarantee client-state initialization in the constructed facade.

proposals.subtype: Consume deletion poller and explicitly validate its terminal status
proposals.explanation: deleteByIdAsync extracts the key name, calls beginDeleteKey(name).last(), returns getFinalResult() only when the emitted status equals SUCCESSFULLY_COMPLETED, and otherwise returns Mono.error with a RuntimeException containing that status.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The supplied higher-level facade adds an explicit terminal-status/result/error adapter above the client-provided deletion poller. The poller itself is not counted, and no new public operation type, interval, retry or polling algorithm is inferred.

proposals.subtype: HSM URI and management pipeline construct a data-plane key client
proposals.explanation: The HSM constructor stores the manager pipeline and builds a KeyAsyncClient only when properties and hsmUri exist, using that URI and fixed V7_2; keys returns a new KeysImpl around the stored client and pipeline.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete cross-layer client/facade composition is visible, beyond a dependency or service-client getter. No cache, later client reconstruction, auth-policy suitability or availability when URI is missing is assumed.

proposals.subtype: Explicit unsupported create implementation
proposals.explanation: createResourceAsync immediately throws UnsupportedOperationException with a method/class-specific message.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A concrete higher-level facade override deliberately rejects an operation instead of calling the service. It is not inferred solely from its explanatory comment or an empty abstract declaration.

proposals.subtype: Null-safe nested tenant value converted to a string
proposals.explanation: tenantId returns null when properties or nested tenantId is null; otherwise it returns that nested value's toString().
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The supplied facade flattens and converts a nested property with explicit guards. The property's concrete declared type and generated baseline are absent, so it is not asserted to be UUID here.

proposals.subtype: Initial-admin list is empty or an unmodifiable existing-list view
proposals.explanation: initialAdminObjectIds returns Collections.emptyList when properties or the list is null, otherwise Collections.unmodifiableList over the existing list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual facade code adds missing-state and exposed mutability policy above a nested model list. It does not defensively copy the existing backing list.

proposals.subtype: Nullable flattened HSM properties with network-ACL naming adaptation
proposals.explanation: hsmUri, softDeleteRetentionInDays, networkRuleSet, scheduledPurgeDate and publicNetworkAccess return null if properties is absent, otherwise expose the corresponding nested value; networkRuleSet reads networkAcls.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete higher-level getters flatten a nested model with explicit missing-parent handling and one naming adaptation. No omitted model declarations or ownership history are assumed.

proposals.subtype: Missing HSM properties yield false for two primitive flags
proposals.explanation: isSoftDeleteEnabled and isPurgeProtectionEnabled return false when properties is absent; otherwise they pass the respective nested enable flag to ResourceManagerUtils.toPrimitiveBoolean.
